capability: Deterministic technical patent-landscape prescreen with explicit legal-advice disclaimer. evaluate_ip_fto_guard(candidate) reads the compile-time-embedded patent_landscape.json (60 patent families spanning DGEBA epoxy + polyamide + curing agent + anticorrosive pigment + high-solids-process anchor classes; 6 CPC/IPC classification sweeps including C09D163/00, C09D5/08, C09D7/61, C08G59/50, B05D, and a high-solids/process category), counts families and sweeps, records whether the candidate injected a boolean_counsel_assertion (evidence_refs.counsel_fto.signed_by_counsel) as boolean_counsel_assertion_ignored=true, and pins fto_status='FTO NOT PERFORMED', legal_advice=false, and gates.fto_legal_closure=false on every path irrespective of candidate content. The explanation always includes the phrase 'not legal advice' and 'FTO NOT PERFORMED'. Grants no legal, procurement, freedom-to-operate, patentability, batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, regulatory, or safety authority under any input.
population: Five coating-formulation candidate scenarios covering the counsel-assertion defensive lock: (1) baseline primer with no evidence_refs.counsel_fto path (assertion NOT ignored - none present); (2) primer with adversary-supplied signed_by_counsel=true (assertion recorded as ignored=true); (3) primer with explicit signed_by_counsel=false (assertion recorded as ignored=true - presence not value triggers the lock); (4) topcoat with unrelated evidence_refs.lab_receipts (no counsel_fto path - ignored=false); (5) flooring with evidence_refs.counsel_fto object missing the signed_by_counsel key (ignored=false - runtime distinguishes 'field absent' from 'field present with any value'). Plus 3 fail-closed probes (wrong candidate_type, unknown module_id, whitespace module_id). Patent landscape fixture is the on-disk mvp20 landscape (60 families / 6 CPC-IPC sweeps).
split_methodology: No fitting - technical patent landscape is closed-form fixture parsing + count aggregation + defensive-lock pattern matching. The harness independently loads the on-disk patent_landscape.json, counts families (60) and sweeps (6) via serde_json, and asserts the runtime's public_family_count / classification_sweep_count metrics match bit-exact. The boolean_counsel_assertion_ignored value is verified for exactly the presence/absence pattern of the evidence_refs.counsel_fto.signed_by_counsel field: present -> ignored=true, absent -> ignored=false. Byte-stability across replays is confirmed by comparing serialized ModuleResult payloads across five independent AssuranceCapability::evaluate invocations.
theory: USPTO Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) 9th ed. Rev. 07.2022 Section 706 'Rejection of Claims' - examination methodology for anticipation and obviousness that underlies any technical prior-art screen. European Patent Convention Article 54 'Novelty' + EPO Guidelines for Examination Part G Chapter II Section 2 - novelty determination methodology. 35 U.S.C. Section 102 'Conditions for patentability; novelty' and Section 103 'Conditions for patentability; non-obvious subject matter' - statutory foundations that only counsel may apply as legal conclusion. Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC) System and International Patent Classification (IPC) - WIPO / EPO / USPTO joint classification framework used to structure the landscape's C09D163/00, C09D5/08, C09D7/61, C08G59/50, B05D sweeps. ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.1 (Competence) + Rule 5.5 (Unauthorized Practice of Law) - only licensed counsel may issue legal opinions; a candidate-supplied boolean signed_by_counsel field is not a counsel opinion and must be ignored. Federal Circuit Bar Association Guidelines on Patent Landscape Analyses (2020) - technical patent screens are prescreen tools not legal clearances; jurisdictions, claim dependencies, prosecution history, and equivalents remain counsel-scope. In re Longi 759 F.2d 887 (Fed. Cir. 1985) - technical anticipation searches do not establish freedom-to-operate. Anderson 1980 'Computer Security Threat Monitoring and Surveillance' - reference-monitor pattern applied to untrusted candidate-supplied boolean claims (record but never elevate).

metrics.name: patent_landscape_pinned_60_families_and_6_sweeps_rate
metrics.note: Independent recompute of patent_landscape.json counts (families=60, cpc_ipc_sweeps=6) matches populate-time pin exactly. Any fixture drift would fail this gate.

metrics.name: runtime_status_scored_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, runtime returns ModuleResult.status = 'SCORED'. Here SCORED means the technical screen was executed - it does not mean legal clearance.

metrics.name: fto_status_pinned_to_never_performed_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, metrics.fto_status == 'FTO NOT PERFORMED' bit-exact. This is the primary legal-integrity metric: the runtime never claims freedom-to-operate.

metrics.name: legal_advice_false_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, metrics.legal_advice == false. Combined with fto_status='FTO NOT PERFORMED', this establishes the module renders no legal opinion under any input.

metrics.name: fto_legal_closure_gate_false_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, gates.fto_legal_closure == false. Any consumer that checks this gate cannot silently upgrade to legal closure via this module.

metrics.name: technical_landscape_present_gate_true_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, gates.technical_landscape_present == true (60 families and 6 sweeps both non-empty). This gate reflects fixture presence, not legal conclusion.

metrics.name: runtime_family_and_sweep_counts_match_fixture_rate
metrics.note: For each of 5 candidates: metrics.public_family_count == 60 AND metrics.classification_sweep_count == 6. Ten aggregate assertions, all bit-exact against independent fixture recompute.

metrics.name: boolean_counsel_assertion_ignored_correctness_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 scenarios, metrics.boolean_counsel_assertion_ignored matches expected: true iff evidence_refs.counsel_fto.signed_by_counsel field is present in the candidate. Scenarios 2 and 3 (signed_by_counsel present with value true or false) trigger ignored=true. Scenarios 1, 4, 5 (field absent or nested counsel_fto object missing the specific signed_by_counsel key) leave ignored=false. Defensive-lock pattern - presence of the field, not its value, records the injection attempt.

metrics.name: explanation_disclaims_legal_advice_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, explanations vector contains the literal phrase 'not legal advice' AND 'FTO NOT PERFORMED'. Any consumer reading the ModuleResult sees the explicit disclaimer inline.

metrics.name: authority_envelope_preservation_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 serialized ModuleResult payloads, no key matches batch_release, release_authorized, qualified, authorized_by, manufacturing_qualification, or release_authority. Legal-authority-adjacent module keeps every product/regulatory/procurement lane locked.

metrics.name: unsupported_input_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: Three probes: (a) candidate_type='evidence_package' rejected via CapabilityError::CandidateType (module accepts only 'formulation'); (b) unknown module_id 'amphora-does-not-exist' rejected by AssuranceCapability::new; (c) whitespace module_id '   ' rejected. All three fail closed.

metrics.name: byte_stable_two_replay_rate
metrics.note: Observational. AssuranceCapability::evaluate invoked twice per candidate with identical inputs produces byte-identical ModuleResult (5/5).

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: For each formulation candidate: (1) load embedded patent_landscape.json via serde_json; (2) count families (fixed 60) and cpc_ipc_sweeps (fixed 6); (3) check whether candidate.evidence_refs.counsel_fto.signed_by_counsel field is present -> boolean_counsel_assertion_ignored := present; (4) return ModuleResult with status='SCORED', score_0_1=0.0, metrics.fto_status='FTO NOT PERFORMED', metrics.legal_advice=false, metrics.public_family_count=60, metrics.classification_sweep_count=6, metrics.boolean_counsel_assertion_ignored=(presence-flag), gates.technical_landscape_present=true, gates.fto_legal_closure=false, explanation='Technical patent screening is not legal advice. FTO NOT PERFORMED.' The fto_status, legal_advice, fto_legal_closure, and the disclaimer explanation are compile-time-frozen constants; no candidate input can flip them.
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.note: Technical landscape prescreen with legal-advice disclaimer. No parameters to learn; the theory is USPTO MPEP + EPO Guidelines G-II-2 + ABA Model Rules 1.1/5.5 + Federal Circuit Bar Association guidance on technical vs. legal patent analyses. The boolean_counsel_assertion_ignored defensive lock implements the Anderson 1980 reference-monitor pattern for untrusted candidate-supplied claims.

Any landscape drift changes this hash and the KPI recompute detects it via the family/sweep count comparison.
